title: Simulating ORION-10
text: ORION-10 (NCT03399370) tested inclisiran, drug lowers LDL cholesterol, placebo. randomized 1,561 adults atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease: 781 inclisiran 780 placebo. Doses given Days 1, 90, 270 450. trial’s statistical analysis plan (SAP) defines main analysis mixed model repeated measures (MMRM). outcome percent change LDL baseline visit. model fixed effects treatment, visit, treatment visit, baseline LDL. uses unstructured covariance, REML Kenward-Roger degrees freedom.

code: ldl$subject_id <- factor(ldl$subject_id)  fit <- mmrm::mmrm(   ldl_pct_change ~ treatment * visit + ldl_baseline + us(visit | subject_id),   data = ldl,   reml = TRUE,   method = "Kenward-Roger" ) means <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ treatment | visit) diffs <- summary(emmeans::contrast(means, "revpairwise")) diffs #> visit = Day 150: #>  contrast             estimate   SE   df t.ratio p.value #>  Inclisiran - Placebo    -59.8 1.16 1559 -51.635 <0.0001 #>  #> visit = Day 270: #>  contrast             estimate   SE   df t.ratio p.value #>  Inclisiran - Placebo    -51.9 1.36 1560 -38.165 <0.0001 #>  #> visit = Day 330: #>  contrast             estimate   SE   df t.ratio p.value #>  Inclisiran - Placebo    -61.8 1.22 1559 -50.824 <0.0001 #>  #> visit = Day 450: #>  contrast             estimate   SE   df t.ratio p.value #>  Inclisiran - Placebo    -48.6 1.34 1560 -36.176 <0.0001 #>  #> visit = Day 510: #>  contrast             estimate   SE   df t.ratio p.value #>  Inclisiran - Placebo    -57.3 1.20 1560 -47.578 <0.0001 #>  #> visit = Day 540: #>  contrast             estimate   SE   df t.ratio p.value #>  Inclisiran - Placebo    -54.8 1.25 1560 -43.733 <0.0001 c(   day_510 = diffs$estimate[diffs$visit == "Day 510"],   time_adjusted = mean(diffs$estimate) ) #>       day_510 time_adjusted  #>     -57.33066     -55.70184
